{{Quote|What's the status of the science vessel?|[[Royce Hemlock]], to [[Scorch]]|<ref name="Flash Strike" />}}
The '''Imperial research transport''', also simply called a '''science vessel''',<ref name="Breach" /> was a type of [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[transport]] utilized for the capture, containment and transport of various [[cloning]] experiments conducted by the [[Advanced Science Division]]. It was manned by [[Clone commando|Imperial commandos]] led by [[Imperial royal guard]]s. One such transport, [[transport 904]], saw its [[Zillo Beast]] "[[Specimen A]]" escape while traveling in [[hyperspace]]; the escaped beast rampaged through the ship consuming the crew and damaging its systems, forcing it to drop out of hyperspace before reaching its destination and crash-landing on [[Silla]]. The reinforced walls kept the beast contained inside, until [[Clone Force 99]] arrived to salvage any valuables still inside and encountered the beast, which gave chase to them and eventually escaped when they accidentally blew a hole through a wall.<ref name="Metamorphosis" />

==Characteristics==
The [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] research [[Starship|vessel]] was a class of massive [[transport]] utilized by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial cloning program|cloning program]] to transport [[Cloning|cloned]] [[Zillo Beast]]s from their facilities scattered around the [[galaxy]] to the [[Tantiss Base]] containment zone on [[Wayland]]. They were manned by [[Clone commando|Imperial commandos]] led by an [[Imperial royal guard]] commando and carried at least one [[Imperial nanny droid|medical droid]] for the Beast. To ensure maximum operational security, their destination was undeclared and not logged on the ship's [[Navigation computer|computer]] to prevent enemies from finding out about Wayland; the vessels were also unmarked to prevent identification in case they crashed.<ref name="Metamorphosis" />

[[File:Zillo_beast_attacked.png|left|thumb|290x290px|An Imperial research transport attacks an escaped Zillo Beast specimen]]
To contain the creatures onboard, they were carried in a juvenile state inside a massive [[glass]] tube-like cell filled with a clear liquid that put it to [[Prison|stasis]]. The laboratory's walls were reinforced and designed to withstand the Beast's attacks and keep it contained inside in case it escaped its tube, while the troopers carried high-volt [[electrostaff]]s that could severely damage the creature. Because the ships were also used to recapture Zillo Beasts in case they escaped altogether, they were armed with a single ventral [[NNJ-40 "Thunderbolt" long-range ion cannon]] that fired a powerful stun beam which could put them to sleep with as little as three repeated hits. Special intervention teams comprised of at least three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] carrying multiple [[Low Altitude Assault Transport]]s and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] were on standby to suppress the creature until it could be stunned.<ref name="Metamorphosis" />
